scope: ADR-0085 P4 real compound-research journey and per-handoff fault matrix. One compound ResearchTask is driven through the real Product API and the real DSH/runtime-adapter boundary: create compound task -> conversation continuation grant -> strategy approval -> data ready -> backtest execute approval -> three rounds of complete/analyse/revise -> deterministic best-result selection -> simulated-account approval/creation -> ResearchTask completed. At each real asynchronous hand-off an isolated non-production component restart (Gateway/Backend/Runtime Adapter/Worker) is injected and no duplicate ResearchTask/plan/artifact/experiment/backtest/order/account may exist and approval/event/stage-call/continuation-budget/generation/receipt state must be exact. The model may only ever see the bounded P3 stage projection. This is maintenance/stability evidence for 0.9.1; it does not deploy, does not write a version number, does not create/move any tag or release, does not run a production canary, does not resume Phase 100 and does not start 0.10.
llm_evidence_note: A keyless deterministic scripted provider drives the journey through the real DSH/runtime-adapter and Product API boundaries. This is service-boundary and contract evidence, NOT real-LLM research-quality semantic evidence; any semantic claim that needs a paid real model is recorded as a maintainer canary requirement, never as PASS.

required_journey_steps.description: A compound research task is created through the real Product API; exactly one ResearchTask exists.
A conversation continuation grant is established and exactly one execution plan is created for the task.
The bounded research-judgment turn at strategy_draft uses <=2 durable model calls, exposes only the bounded stage projection, and advances the plan to waiting_for_strategy_approval.
The exact plan-bound strategy approval is requested and approved; the plan advances deterministically with zero model calls.
The exact plan-bound backtest-task-create approval is requested and approved; the plan advances deterministically.
The deterministic create action submits the exact backtest task identity; the plan advances to waiting_for_data.
A completed signal job with a validated snapshot is recorded by exact job identity; the plan advances with zero model calls.
The exact plan-bound backtest-execute approval is requested and approved; the plan advances deterministically.
The deterministic execute action queues the exact backtest job; the plan advances to waiting_for_backtest_job.
A terminal backtest job is recorded by exact job identity; the plan advances to backtest_analysis with zero model calls.
The bounded backtest-analysis judgment turn advances the plan to iteration_comparison.
Two further rounds advance iteration 1->2->3 through the exact create gate, never skipping an iteration.
The final-selection judgment deterministically selects the best round and converges the plan to completed.
The simulated account is approved and created exactly once through the bound approval and Product API.
ResearchTask, plan, RuntimeSession/Generation, continuation receipt and Product projection agree on completion.

required_fault_scenarios.description: Restart the Gateway after the bound approval request is durable and before the decision; after recovery the same approval binding is reused and no duplicate approval/event/plan exists.
Restart the Backend after a data-ready event is admitted but before its consumer settles; after recovery there is exactly one advanced plan and no duplicate event.
Restart the Runtime Adapter after a durable stage-call admission but before the result commit; after recovery the admission is replayed free and no third call is created.
Restart the backtest worker while a job is running; after recovery the job terminates once and the plan advances once.
Restart the Gateway after the backtest-completed event is recorded; after recovery no duplicate analysis stage call or event exists.
Restart the Backend between claiming and settling a durable pending intent; the same claimant resumes the claim exactly once and a foreign claimant is refused.
Replay the exact same source identity; the durable ledger row is returned and no second advance or business object is written.
A stale/late event for an already-advanced plan records needs_attention and never advances the newer plan.
